prompt: Leave the voicemail where Dad confirms Sunday's game plans and also mentions your oil probably needs changing.
response:
Here are a few options, depending on your dad's "vibe."

**Option 1: The Classic, Distracted Dad**
*(Sound of a car door closing in the background)*
"Hey, it's your old man. Just calling to lock in Sunday—kickoff's at one, so I'm firing up the grill around noon. Don't be late, and grab a bag of ice on your way over, will ya? Oh, and I pulled your car out of the driveway this morning to get mine out... you're about a quart low and that oil looks darker than my coffee. You've gotta change that this weekend, or you're gonna blow the engine. Alright, see you Sunday. Go Birds."

**Option 2: The Short & Efficient Dad**
"Calling to confirm Sunday. My house, 12:30. Burgers and dogs. Bring the chips. Also, I checked your dipstick when I borrowed the ladder—needs an oil change. Don't put it off. Let me know if you need me to pick up the filter. Bye."

**Option 3: The Sarcastic Dad**
"Just a heads-up, since you never answer your texts: Game's at my place Sunday, 1 p.m. Try not to get lost on the way. Also, your car started sounding like a diesel tractor when you left last night, so I checked the oil. It’s basically sludge. If you want to actually make it here Sunday, I suggest you change it Saturday. Love you, don't kill your engine. Click."
